messages:
sam: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we need concrete owners and deadlines for rollout safety improvements. Main buckets: panic button (manual stop), automated rollbacks (multi-signal), and rollout telemetry. Who volunteers?
lina: I can take telemetry + dashboards. Goal: expose "rollout_fraction" and "flag_error_rate" metrics per-flag, with 1h retention for quick backfills. ETA: next Thu.
omar: I'll own the automated rollback logic. Thinking: require 2 concurrent signals to trigger auto-rollback (error_rate > X AND p95 latency > Y for N mins). Will draft a decision matrix + config model. ETA: 10 days.
nora: Ops will own the panic button and runbook. Need a simple HTTP endpoint + Console button that flips the flag to 0% and posts to #incidents. I'll prototype a UI mock by Friday.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: automated-incident-link: postmortem 789 created -> please attach follow-ups: https://redwood/postmortems/789
sam: Proposed default safe settings (waivable per-flag): default_max_pct=5, default_safety_window=1800 (30m), auto_rb: [error_rate_5m>0.04, p95_10m>1500ms, sustained_3m]. We should make these editable per-flag and require signoff by SLO owners.
lina: Agree on defaults. I'll add those as columns in the rollout dashboard and add alerts: warning at 50% of threshold, critical at threshold. Alert destinations: #eng-oncall + PagerDuty.
omar: Example config I'll add to the design doc:
```
rollout_policy:
  max_fraction: 0.05
  safety_window_secs: 1800
  auto_rollback:
    require_signals: 2
    signals:
      - name: error_rate_5m
        threshold: 0.04
      - name: p95_latency_10m
        threshold_ms: 1500
    sustained_secs: 180
```
sam: Nice. Also add a behavioral test in CI that simulates a spike and verifies automation flips the flag and notifies #incidents. This will prevent regressions.
nora: Runbook sketch: 1) on alert, check rollout dashboard 2) if automated RB fired, confirm with incident lead then validate downstream services 3) if manual panic invoked, call the ops pager and escalate. I'll add playbook buttons for "pause rollout" and "force rollback".
lina: Minor ask: emit a histogram of rollout_fraction per minute so we can reconstruct user impact during investigations. Without that, backfill is hard.
omar: We'll need a small library in the runtime to read flag metadata and enforce caps. I can own the runtime change, but need API contract from ops/console team for the panic endpoint.
sam: Action items summary I'll add to the postmortem tracker: telemetry (lina) 1w, auto-rollback design + prototype (omar) 10d, panic endpoint + UI (nora) 2w, CI tests + integration (sam) 2w. Recurring task: quarterly review of rollout incidents to tune defaults.
devops-bot: reminder: attach PR links and tracker updates to the postmortem.
nora: One more: include a stakeholder review with product/security for any changes that change exposure. CC @product @security when drafts ready.
sam: Perfect. Let's reconvene in the sync on Tue to lock owners and dates. If anyone can't meet, drop a comment on the tracker. Thanks all.
